name: London Oxford Airport

hours.v: Open 06:30–22:30 local, seven days a week
hours.quote: London Oxford Airport is open from 06:30 to 22:30 seven days a week.

curfew.v: Closed 22:30–06:30 local; extensions between 06:00 and 23:59 can be requested from Operations
curfew.quote: Requests for extensions from 06:00 to 23:59 are accepted seven days a week via Operations

customs.v: Customs/immigration concession airport (GA Agreement); GAR via the UK Government portal 48 h to 2 h before departure (12 h for Ireland, Northern Ireland, Channel Islands, Isle of Man); no 24-hour customs stated

ppr.v: Strict PPR; at least 30 minutes' notice to ATC; a flight plan is not PPR
ppr.quote: Oxford operates a strict 'Prior Permission Required' (PPR) policy.

fuel.quote: Avgas and Jet A1 available at pumps or from bowsers

noise.v: Runway 19: climb straight ahead to 1,000 ft QNH or 1.0 DME before turning right
noise.quote: climb straight ahead to 1000 FT QNH or 1.0 DME I OXF, whichever is the earliest, before turning right.

notes: UK NATS eAIP (nats-uk.ead-it.com) could not be opened in this run (proxy refused the host; WebFetch permission not granted), so no UK AIP AD 2 data was read. Note: the Airport information page says '06:30 – 22:30 opening hours (weekdays)', while the Opening Times page says seven days a week; confirm weekend hours with Operations. GAR window for customs: submit no earlier than 48 h and no later than 2 h before departure.
